about_the_game:
Love The Scouring? Help Us Make More!

Dear Community,

If you’ve enjoyed The Scouring and want to help our small, passionate team keep creating, we’d be incredibly grateful if you checked out our Digital Devlog+Artbook DLC!

This isn’t just an artbook—it’s a backstage pass to the game’s world. Uncover early concepts, scrapped designs, and the stories behind The Scouring’s art. Every page is a piece of our hearts—and your support means everything to us.

Why grab it?
✨ Behind-the-scenes secrets: See how the game’s visuals evolved from sketch to screen.
✨ Directly support us: Sales help fund more content, updates, and fixes—we’ve got big plans!
✨ Exclusive rewards: We’re prepping a roadmap with perks for supporters (stay tuned!).

✨ Special insignia ⭐ opposite the game nickname in multiplayer 

We need your help. As a tiny team, every DLC purchase lets us invest more time into The Scouring’s future. Want more modes, races, units, heroes, or lore? You’re making it possible!

Access to Digital Devlog+Artbook via main menu. Only English version.

Orc Group

P.S. Tag us with your favorite art—we’ll hug you (gently, no orc strength).
